notes: CAPA: a new "Down time >= (min)" box at the top of the CAPA list sets how long a breakdown must last to become a CAPA. It is 55 minutes by default for every month; an admin can pick a month and give it its own limit, and Use default puts that month back. Everyone else just sees the limit. A CAPA that is already started or filled always stays in the list even if the limit is raised later.
